description: What it does Image Outliner turns JPG, PNG, and WEBP images into clean outlines, line drawings, edge maps, sticker-style PNG outlines, printable stencils, and Cricut-ready cut lines. Why use it - Runs instant local previews in your browser, so you can test styles without signing up. - Lets you adjust stroke width, smoothing, edge threshold, color, and transparent output. - Downloads PNG results for stickers, coloring pages, craft projects, laser cutting drafts, tattoo references, and design work
